title: PTCalc: open computational tools for pharmaceutical technology
description:
Open-source web application (Blazor Server, .NET 10) and library for pharmaceutical technology computations. Modules: (1) dissolution-kinetics engine with 16 release models fitted by nonlinear least squares in the F(%) domain, AIC/AICc/MSC ranking and Akaike weights, Korsmeyer–Peppas F≤60% rule, Hopfenberg geometry exponents including the Karasulu half-sphere and triangle, results compared with DDSolver 1.0 outputs; (2) pseudo-ternary phase-diagram tool with polygon area and centroid calculation, in use since 2001; (3) f1/f2 similarity factors and model-independent profile metrics; (4) dose–response (LD50) by probit, logit and 4PL; (5) laboratory statistics: t-test, one-way ANOVA with Tukey HSD, multiple linear regression with prediction intervals, and calibration curves with LOD/LOQ following ICH Q2(R2), compared with SciPy and statsmodels; (6) alcoholometry from the OIML R 22 water–ethanol equation: dilution recipes by volume or weight with volume contraction, and density–strength conversions, compared with the printed OIML tables. Detailed bilingual guides with DOI-verified references accompany the tools. Sites: https://ptcalc.net (English), https://ptcalc.tr (Turkish).

Türkçe: Farmasötik teknoloji için açık kaynak hesaplama araçları: dissolüsyon kinetiği motoru, psödo-üçlü faz diyagramı, f1/f2 benzerlik faktörleri, doz–yanıt, t-testi/ANOVA/regresyon/kalibrasyon ve OIML R 22 alkolometri.
